teams.detail: Landed 4-star CB Censere Gaylord as Jedd Fisch's staff fills out the class. Season opens with the Apple Cup vs. Washington State, moved to Sunday, Sept. 6 at Husky Stadium.
Croatian forward Boris Tišma committed as Danny Sprinkle rebuilds after a 16-17 season. Forward Hannes Steinbach went No. 14 to the Hornets in the 2026 NBA Draft.

Defending Super Bowl LX champs opened camp Friday as veterans reported. Season opens Sept. 9 vs. New England in a Super Bowl rematch; several players and coaches attended Monday's Mariners game with the Lombardi Trophy.

Coming off a 60-win season, Detroit added Isaiah Joe, John Collins, Gary Harris and Taurean Prince (CBS gave the offseason a 'C'). RFA center Jalen Duren remains at a standstill with the team; talks could stretch into August.

Mariners (51-52) dropped the series to Cincinnati on Sal Stewart's go-ahead three-run homer in a 5-3 loss Wednesday, sitting one game back of Texas in the AL West. Bryce Miller (4-4, 2.27 ERA) starts tonight's series opener at Rangers.

headlines.headline: LeBron James signs with 76ers for historic 24th season, calls it his 'last decision'
headlines.detail: James agreed to a two-year, $8 million deal with Philadelphia after telling the Lakers he wouldn't return, ending an eight-year run in LA that included the 2020 title; the 41-year-old four-time champion said he believes he can help make the 76ers 'a championship team' as he begins an unprecedented 24th NBA season.

headlines.headline: Panthers' Nic Scourton tears ACL on day one of training camp as all 32 teams open camp
headlines.detail: Carolina's second-year edge rusher, who posted 47 tackles and five sacks as a 2025 rookie starter, tore his ACL on a wet field during Thursday's opening practice - a major blow opposite newly signed Jaelan Phillips - as all 32 NFL teams report to camp by July 28, with Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes separately confirming he's been cleared to practice after his December ACL/LCL tear.

headlines.headline: SEC Media Days wrap in Tampa with Lane Kiffin's LSU debut and a three-year title drought looming
headlines.detail: The four-day SEC Media Days closed Thursday in Tampa with LSU, Arkansas, Mississippi State and Texas taking the podium, headlined by Lane Kiffin's first appearance as LSU's coach after his move from Ole Miss; the conference enters its first nine-game schedule with six new head coaches and no national title since the 2022 season, as the Big Ten has won the last three championships.

headlines.headline: 5-star 2027 PG Cayden Daughtry ignites blue-blood bidding war after record-shattering Peach Jam
headlines.detail: Daughtry led the Florida Rebels to the Nike EYBL Peach Jam championship while averaging 32.3 points, 6.1 assists, 4.9 rebounds and 2.9 steals over his final eight games on 59% shooting, rocketing him to No. 3 in the 2027 class and setting off an active recruiting battle led by Kentucky, which extended an offer in May.
